title: Kenyan Plantain Bake
description: A twist on traditional Kenyan cuisine, this Mexican-inspired dish is a sweet and savory fusion of roasted plantains and spicy spices.
instructions: Peel and slice plantains into 1-inch rounds.
In a large bowl, mix together spice blend, brown sugar, cardamom, and cinnamon.
Add melted coconut oil to the spice mixture and stir until combined.
Add sliced plantains to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Transfer the plantains to a baking dish and cover with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the plantains are tender and caramelized.
